zh-CN.title: 头像框在每个尺寸都保持一致
items: 头像框会随头像等比例缩放，小头像和大预览保持相同粗细
边框紧贴头像并共享同一轮廓，不再出现圆框与圆角头像错位
装饰被限制在固定头像范围内，不会挤占列表空间或覆盖相邻内容

en.title: Avatar frames now stay consistent at every size
items: Frames scale proportionally so compact avatars and large previews keep the same visual weight
Frames now hug the avatar and share its silhouette instead of mixing circles with rounded portraits
Ornaments remain inside a fixed avatar footprint and no longer collide with nearby content
